body_markdown:
[MikeO3](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/MikeO3)


October 6, 2026, 12:37pm 1


Use case: I use automation to auto tag stories based on ticker, company, sector, etc. which let’s me drill-down on specifics when I want to read stuff.


Problem: There does not be appear to be an ability to sort the tags a-z, z-a, date, etc. which makes it difficult to find specifics in the default sort order. The list must be scrolled top to bottom which takes {if/and/or/not} process in my head since the sort is rather random!


Currently, the order appears to be by story tag counts.


[image 298×642 28.8 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/f/f0e7b4d79245efe4e77b90add8f8b950956a1b37.png)


Adding a menu item is probably not a small task but it would be awesome to see a *Tags* preference items added.


[image 267×355 25 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/6/68bdd535154be5e6d769e4c5252849052559cef8.png)
